__comment: Craft recipes by section: Rudimentary (Workers) unless a recipe names its `section`, which the career with that craft_section makes (professions.json, doc 292). `catch_log` names the Ranger's log count a batch adds to. A recipe with `dry_hours` leaves its batch on the workshop that long (the drying rack's fish, doc 292): the workshop holds it, then a Ranger takes it down in `collect_seconds` (Task COLLECT). CraftingManager is the single data owner. ingredient_count matching timber units per batch, plus one unit per additional_ingredients entry, physically collected before work. output_count is finished units. Finite quantities are batches; maintain quantities are spare units. The first bench needs no workshop. Tools can be crafted and stored. A career's own workbench is made by that career at the crude workbench from raw goods (doc 293). ingredient_tag names the material tag of the batch's goods (timber, fish, or stockpile_stone for the Rough Stone alone), and ingredient_words how the window and waiting reasons word them (timber's when absent).

recipes.name: Crude workbench
recipes.description: A rough stump with an axe-hewn top for the colony's first crafts. Workers can make it on clear ground, then haul and install it through Place.
recipes.flavour: Every hall began as a stump and a dwarf with an axe.

recipes.name: Log torch
recipes.description: A charred branch bound with rough fibre and held by a wooden wall peg. A basic light for the first tunnels.
recipes.flavour: Dark corners breed rumours. Light them.

recipes.name: Ladder section
recipes.description: Split raw timber into pegged rails and rungs. Each section installs four blocks; taller routes need several sections.
recipes.flavour: Down is easy. Up is where the rungs earn their keep.

recipes.name: Campfire
recipes.description: A low outdoor stone-ring fire, centered in a 3 × 3 camp area. Place stools around its edges to gather by the light.
recipes.flavour: Stones in a ring, logs in the middle, stories all around.
recipes.purpose: Outdoor gathering and light. A worker lights it at dusk with a log; it burns until dawn.

recipes.name: Rudimentary hearth
recipes.description: A 2 × 2 hearthstone with a stacked stone fire-back: an open fire that throws its heat into the room. Two matching logs and four rough stones.
recipes.flavour: A room with a hearth is a home; without one, a cellar.
recipes.purpose: Warms a small enclosed bedroom at night. Face the opening into the room; larger rooms may need more heat. A worker lights it at dusk with a log; it burns until dawn.

recipes.name: Log stool
recipes.description: A short log cut flat for sitting, with rough bark sides. A simple stump seat for the first camp.
recipes.flavour: Sit low, eat well, argue loudly.
recipes.purpose: Idle dwarves can sit here and return to work when needed.

recipes.name: Log dining table
recipes.description: A broad log slice joined to a narrow central pedestal. Made from two matching logs.
recipes.flavour: A table turns a meal into a feast, and a feast into a story.
recipes.purpose: Add separate stools at the four guides for seated dining.

recipes.name: Stone hoe
recipes.description: A shaped stone blade fitted to a wooden haft for the colony's first fields.
recipes.flavour: Even a stone blade wakes the soil.
recipes.purpose: Farmer starter tool. Farming and equipping tools are planned; this item can be crafted and stored.

recipes.name: Ranger's kit
recipes.description: A stone-tipped spear and a peeled fishing rod, bound with rope. Needs no metal or bowstring.
recipes.flavour: A rod for the river, a spear for the woods.
recipes.purpose: The Ranger's starter tool: a dwarf promoted to Ranger collects one. They fish with its rod; the spear waits for hunting.

recipes.name: Crude carpentry kit
recipes.description: A wooden mallet and stone adze for rough woodworking. An iron saw can be a later upgrade.
recipes.flavour: Every carpenter's first tools were made by someone who wasn't one.
recipes.purpose: Required to promote a Carpenter. The dwarf collects and equips this kit.

recipes.name: Crude masonry kit
recipes.description: A hammerstone maul and a long stone point on two hafts, bound side by side. Needs no metal.
recipes.flavour: Stone shapes stone, if you hit it hard enough.
recipes.purpose: Required to promote a Stonemason. The dwarf collects and equips this kit.

recipes.name: Stone hammer
recipes.description: A heavy stone head fitted to a wooden handle for the colony's first metalworking tools.
recipes.flavour: The first hammer is always the heaviest.
recipes.purpose: Blacksmith starter tool. Smelting, forging and equipping tools are planned; this item can be crafted and stored.

recipes.name: Log door (2 wide)
recipes.description: One rough log leaf swings open as dwarves approach. Fits a 2-block-wide opening and seals the room for warmth.
recipes.flavour: A door is a wall that learned manners.

recipes.name: Log door (3 wide)
recipes.description: One rough log leaf swings open as dwarves approach. Fits a 3-block-wide opening and seals the room for warmth.
recipes.flavour: Wide enough for a barrel, snug enough to stop the draught.

recipes.name: Double log door (4 wide)
recipes.description: Two rough log leaves swing open as dwarves approach. Fits a 4-block-wide opening and seals the room for warmth.
recipes.flavour: Big doors for big halls, and bigger quarrels over who left them open.

recipes.name: Log bench
recipes.description: An axe-hewn half log resting on two stout log supports. Simple camp seating.
recipes.flavour: Room for three dwarves, or two after supper.

recipes.name: Log bed
recipes.description: Fit rough logs into a low frame and heap it with hay and dried leaves. A simple place for one dwarf to sleep.
recipes.flavour: Straw on logs beats stone on stone.
recipes.purpose: Dwarves prefer a free bed over the ground. A bed, door, light and sealed enclosure make a bedroom.

recipes.name: Log Fence Post
recipes.description: Stands in the middle of a tile. Two level rails join posts on neighboring tiles, forming straight runs, corners and junctions.
recipes.flavour: A row of posts tells beasts and neighbours where the colony begins.

recipes.name: Log Gate
recipes.description: Hangs across one tile between posts on the tiles either side, sharing posts with connected fences. Opens as dwarves approach and does not seal a room.
recipes.flavour: A fence that knows when to open.

recipes.name: Board-game Table
recipes.description: A game scratched into a rough-cut log, with loose stones for counters. Add one stool for solo play, or two opposite stools to play together for more happiness.
recipes.flavour: Wars have been won, and friendships lost, across this board.

recipes.name: Drying rack
recipes.description: Two forked posts and a crossbar lashed with rope: the Ranger's own workbench. Fish hung along it dry into food that keeps a season. Rangers make it at the crude workbench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: A winter's dinner, hung out in the autumn wind.
recipes.purpose: Rangers dry fresh fish on it, two of a kind at a time, into dried fish that keeps about thirty days.

recipes.name: Carpenter's bench
recipes.description: A thick slab hewn flat on top, on four peeled log legs braced low with log rails: the Carpenter's own workbench. Carpenters make it at the crude workbench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: A bench is a carpenter's first piece and last argument.
recipes.purpose: The Carpenter's own workbench. Carpenters make their goods at it.

recipes.name: Tool rack
recipes.description: Half a split log hewn flat on its face and lashed to a wall on two pegs, with three stout pegs driven in to hang tools on. Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench; it is then installed against a wall through Place.
recipes.flavour: A tool on a peg is a tool you can find.
recipes.purpose: Holds three of the colony's tools, one to a hook. It is filled before ground storage.
recipes.purpose_short: Holds three tools on a wall.

recipes.name: Raw materials crate
recipes.description: Two courses of notched logs laid crossing at the corners, open on top. Made from two matching logs. Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench; it is then installed on the floor through Place.
recipes.flavour: What the mine gives, the crib keeps.
recipes.purpose: Holds twelve raw goods, three to each quarter: Rough Stone, ores and coal, and soil. It is filled before ground storage.
recipes.purpose_short: Holds twelve stones, ores or soil.

recipes.name: Mason's bench
recipes.description: A split stone slab laid across two log stumps: the Stonemason's own workbench. Stonemasons make it at the crude workbench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: Every wall begins on a stone someone knocked square.
recipes.purpose: The Stonemason's own workbench. Stonemasons shape stone at it.

recipes.name: Stone stool
recipes.description: A Rough Stone knocked square all the way down with the maul, its top a little uneven and lumps left on its sides: a stool the log stool's size. Stonemasons make it at the mason's bench; it is then installed through Place.
recipes.flavour: It will outlast the table, the hall and very likely the dwarf.
recipes.purpose: A seat like the log stool: dwarves rest, eat and play on it, it takes a table's guides, and it turns to a nearby fire.
recipes.purpose_short: A seat like the log stool, in stone.

ingredient_words.same: Each stool is one Rough Stone.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a stone to allow it.

recipes.name: Dried fish
recipes.description: Fresh fish split and hung on the drying rack until the air has taken the water out of them: a day on the rack, then a Ranger takes them down. Dried fish keep about thirty days, longer kept cool, where fresh ones keep two.
recipes.flavour: Tough as a boot, and twice as welcome in midwinter.
recipes.purpose: Keeps the summer's catch for winter. Two fish of one kind hang on the rack together for a day.

ingredient_words.same: A batch is two fish of one kind.
ingredient_words.pick: Click a fish to allow it.

sections.name: Rudimentary
sections.hint: Simple goods and starter tools, made by Workers at the crude workbench.

sections.name: Carpenter
sections.description: Timber worked with basic tools, at the Carpenter's own bench.
sections.hint: Carpenters make these: their bench at the crude workbench first, then a tool rack at it. Promote a Carpenter with a carpentry kit.

sections.name: Stonemason
sections.description: Rough stone knocked square, at the Stonemason's own bench.
sections.hint: Stonemasons make these: their bench at the crude workbench first, then stone stools on it. Promote a Stonemason with a masonry kit.

sections.name: Blacksmith
sections.description: Refine metal and forge better tools, fittings, weapons and armor.
sections.requirements: Entry tool: stone hammer. Iron pickaxes and carpenter saws are future upgrades.
sections.hint: The stone hammer is available under Rudimentary › Starter tools.

sections.name: Farmer
sections.description: Grow and harvest crops to supply food, drink and other professions.
sections.requirements: Entry tool: stone hoe. Farming will use field work; its production controls are still planned.
sections.hint: The stone hoe is available under Rudimentary › Starter tools.

sections.name: Ranger
sections.description: Food from the wild, and the Ranger's own workbench: the drying rack now, more with hunting.
later: Hunting supplies, animal goods and more workbenches, such as a rack for drying hides into leather, join this page when hunting comes.
sections.hint: Rangers make these: their drying rack at the crude workbench, then dried fish on it. Promote a Ranger with a Ranger's kit.

sections.name: Miner
sections.description: Miners already specialize in excavation. Their equipment progression will be supplied by other crafts.
sections.requirements: Miner promotion uses the default pickaxe today. Iron and later metal upgrades will be made by the Blacksmith.
sections.hint: Miner is playable; this equipment section is a preview, with no Miner crafting recipes yet.

sections.name: Brewer
sections.description: Turn farm harvests into drinks for the colony.
sections.requirements: Brewing recipes, ingredients and production controls are planned.
sections.hint: Farming and brewing production will be added in later milestones.
